citation.title: Metformin improves skeletal muscle and physical capacity by stabilizing neuromuscular junction in older adults.
citation.authors: Qaisar R; Javed M; Khan IM; Ahmad F; Karim A

identity_and_exposure.dose_as_abstract_reports: 1700 mg of metformin twice a day for 16 weeks
identity_and_exposure.arithmetic_limit: 3400 is the literal arithmetic, not independently verified administered exposure or a regimen recommendation. Do not silently rewrite to1700mg/day or assume850mg twice daily. Full dosing Methods, titration, route, brand, salt, release form, adherence and placebo composition unavailable.

population_and_design.source_context: Geriatric men; primary publisher Methods excerpt specifies non-diabetic men. Ethics context names Burns and Plastic Surgery Center,Peshawar,Pakistan. Exact recruitment location/eligibility dates and thresholds unverified.
population_and_design.randomization_as_reported: Simple randomization, primary Methods excerpt. Sequence generation and concealment unread.
population_and_design.blinding: PubMed indexing includes Double-Blind Method; exact masking implementation not verified from accessible primary Methods.
population_and_design.denominator_limit: Abstract n70/62 sum132, whereas preview randomization n77/71 sum148. Differences7/9 are arithmetic only; no verified disposition, endpoint-specific analyzed n,ITT/per-protocol rule, imputation or AE withdrawal attribution.
population_and_design.baseline_claim: Abstract says baseline HGS,gait speed,SPPB and plasma chemistry similar. Preview says no age/body-composition difference at any time; underlying Table1 and uncertainty definitions are unread. No new significance calculation.

hierarchy_and_analysis.sample_size: Excerpt mentions an RCT sample-size calculator, but target effect, endpoint, alpha,power and resulting requirement unavailable.
hierarchy_and_analysis.statistical_methods: Target paper statistical section unavailable; no paired-test,ANCOVA,interaction or mixed-model attribution borrowed from other papers.
hierarchy_and_analysis.functional_between_arm_contrast: Unknown from available text; no recoverable direct treatment-control change estimate,CI or P value. Do not equate within-arm significance patterns with randomized treatment difference or with proof of zero effect.

mediation.reported: CAF22 correlates significantly with HGS,gait speed and cumulative SPPB in the metformin group; numeric coefficients/timing/adjustments unverified.
mediation.reason: Correlation and circulating marker reduction do not isolate NMJ causal mediation. No formal mediation model, mediator perturbation or direct NMJ assay is documented in the accessible material; unavailable main cannot be assumed to contain none.
